reviews.title: Great picture quality for text/development and gaming
reviews.comment: 3 months now and it works and looks great. 27" works really well for crisp resolution. I have an expensive dell 27" from work next to it and this is brighter and just as clear and crisp. I was hesitant to buy with this product cheaper and less known brand, but so far so good! Packed well and no damage. I code for hours and play games on this monitor.
reviews.author: Peanut

reviews.title: Looks nice
reviews.comment: White monitor matches great with my all white Tower. Quality seems nice but some reason it doesn't connect 4k option for gaming unlike my predator gaming monitor automatically does with the same PC.
